equity.level_reason: Coverage by broad and disaggregated race/ethnicity is framed as inequities and racism is named, but group values and ranges are only set side by side with no computed difference or ratio, so the cap at 2 applies.

level_alternative.reason: Inequities are explicitly framed and interpreted, ranges and highest-vs-lowest values could be read as quantified, and structural racism is named as a root cause.

notes: CIs are computed but no conclusion is drawn from them, so no inversion test is recorded. Disaggregated subgroup comparisons within broad groups are treated as comparison, not stratification, since both levels are race/ethnicity.
view_issues: Abstract gives the Hispanic subgroup range as 10.8%–61.1% but Results give 20.8%–61.1%. Figure 2 note calls 50.0% the lowest Black subgroup value, yet Results give a Black range of 17.1%–50.0%. Figure note says '>1 dose' versus '≥1 dose' in Methods.
